hypothesis: A linear ranking of the 17 runtime-available geometric features can select lower-normalized-corner-error axis candidates more often than the native ranking on source-disjoint synthetic development panels.
isolated_change: Train one 17-to-1 linear scorer on the fixed detected train panels; preserve the production detector, its candidate generation, fallback handling and uncertainty gate.

development_split.limitation: Previously used in development and shares generator and fonts with training; not an independent external acceptance set.

development_metric: Compare native and candidate-selected mean corner error normalized by plot width and height for each uniquely matched detected panel, retain source, fallback, panel and candidate-coverage failure denominators, and report regressions separately.

acceptance_policy.scope: Shared policy applies unchanged; its Tier 2 requires no silently exported unvalidated calibrations and review/block for invalid calibration. It defines no axis corner-error numeric bar.
acceptance_policy.production_promotion: Requires separately admitted development and real sealed acceptance, with the existing uncertainty/review gates preserved.

sealed_budget.rule: No sealed read in this training run. A separately admitted sealed evaluation is considered only after development evidence clears the applicable policy.

training_device: AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT gfx1032 cuda:0
